suggest.doctrine/dbal: If you want to use Doctrine DBAL
suggest.laminas/laminas-db: If you want to use Laminas Db

scripts.test-coverage-pgsql-pdo: export XDEBUG_MODE=coverage DB=pgsql ADAPTER=pdo; phpunit -c ./tests/phpunit.xml --coverage-php build/logs/coverage-pgsql-pdo.cov
scripts.test-coverage-pgsql-laminas-db: export XDEBUG_MODE=coverage DB=pgsql ADAPTER=laminas-db; phpunit -c ./tests/phpunit.xml --coverage-php build/logs/coverage-pgsql-laminas-db.cov
scripts.test-coverage-pgsql-doctrine2: export XDEBUG_MODE=coverage DB=pgsql ADAPTER=doctrine2-dbal; phpunit -c ./tests/phpunit.xml --coverage-php build/logs/coverage-pgsql-doctrine2.cov
scripts.test-coverage-mysql-pdo: export XDEBUG_MODE=coverage DB=mysql ADAPTER=pdo; phpunit -c ./tests/phpunit.xml --coverage-php build/logs/coverage-mysql-pdo.cov
scripts.test-coverage-mysql-laminas-db: export XDEBUG_MODE=coverage DB=mysql ADAPTER=laminas-db; phpunit -c ./tests/phpunit.xml --coverage-php build/logs/coverage-mysql-laminas-db.cov
scripts.test-coverage-mysql-doctrine2: export XDEBUG_MODE=coverage DB=mysql ADAPTER=doctrine2-dbal; phpunit -c ./tests/phpunit.xml --coverage-php build/logs/coverage-mysql-doctrine2.cov
scripts.coverage-merge: mkdir -p build/logs && phpcov merge --clover build/logs/clover.xml build/logs && sed -i 's|/var/src/||g' build/logs/clover.xml
